audience: web developers and shop owners who shrink and convert images with TinyPNG

useCases.title: Compress an image from a URL
useCases.text: The AI compresses a public image by URL and reports the compressed size, type and saving. It can also return the compressed image itself, up to 1 MB.

useCases.title: Resize an image to a given width
useCases.text: The AI compresses an image from a URL, then resizes it, for example to 800 pixels wide. The resized image comes back only when it is under 1 MB; otherwise you get its size and type.

useCases.title: Convert an image to WebP or another format
useCases.text: The AI compresses an image from a URL, then converts it to a format such as WebP, and reports the resulting type and size.

useCases.title: Check how many compressions you used this month
useCases.text: The AI reads the compression count of your key for the calendar month and tells you if the key is valid. It compresses nothing.
